newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money market rates stable in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money market rates stable in slow trade.

text.p: Dutch money market rates remained stable on Monday in slow post-weekend trade.
Dealers said they were looking for alternative trades, but added that activity in Dutch Treasury Certificates (DTCs) and derivatives was also light.
"Prices are not moving and market players are waiting until Tuesday before returning to the market," said one dealer.
Call money remained below 3.00 percent, bidding between 2.88 and 2.95 percent.
The guilder was fractionally stronger versus the German mark at 112.55 per 100 marks compared to 112.56 on Friday.
